name: Easy Menu Manager
author: Aftabul Islam

sections.description:
Easy Menu Manager provides a seamless way to manage your WordPress navigation menus by restricting menu items to specific user roles. With this plugin, you can easily control which menu items are visible to different users, such as logged-in users, logged-out users, or specific roles like ‘Administrator’, ‘Editor’, or ‘Subscriber’.

This is particularly useful for membership sites, e-commerce stores, or any WordPress site that has different user roles with different levels of access to content.

The plugin integrates a user-friendly multi-select dropdown into the WordPress menu editor, allowing you to select one or more user roles for each menu item. If no roles are selected, the menu item will be visible to all users.

Features

  • Restrict Menu Item by User Role: Easily show or hide menu items based on user roles.
  • Multiple Role Support: Assign multiple user roles to a single menu item.
  • Simple User Interface: A simple multi-select dropdown is added to each menu item in the menu editor.
  • Lightweight and Efficient: The plugin is lightweight and does not affect your site’s performance.
  • Seamless Integration: Integrates seamlessly with the WordPress menu management system.
  • Developer Friendly: The plugin is built with developers in mind, with proper hooks and filters.

Used 3rd Party Resources

  • Selectize.js
sections.installation:
1. Upload the easy-menu-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Appearance > Menus.
  4. Click on any menu item to expand its options.
  5. You will see a new field called “Only Visible to Roles”.
  6. Select the user roles that should be able to see the menu item.
  7. Save the menu.
sections.faq:
What happens if I don’t select any role for a menu item?

If you don’t select any role for a menu item, it will be visible to all users, both logged-in and logged-out.

Can I select multiple roles for a single menu item?

Yes, you can select multiple roles. The menu item will be visible to users who have any of the selected roles.

Does this plugin work with custom user roles?

Yes, it works with any custom user roles created by other plugins or by your theme.
